name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the accession of Montenegro to the Convention of 2 July 2019 on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Judgments in Civil or Commercial Matters
part_text:
The European Parliament supports Montenegro joining a global agreement on recognising court judgments in civil and commercial cases. The agreement helps people and businesses in one country have court decisions enforced in another, saving time and money. Montenegro signed up in February 2025, and the agreement is set to take effect between the European Union and Montenegro on 1 March 2026. The Parliament also says the European Union should follow its formal procedure when deciding on future accessions by other countries.

- Montenegro joins the agreement; court judgments will be recognised between it and the European Union from 1 March 2026.
- People and businesses involved in cross-border civil and commercial cases benefit from clearer, faster enforcement.
- The European Union should use its formal procedure for future accessions by other countries.
